name: Campllong (Spain)
description: Red field charged at the centre with a white rose barbed and seeded yellow.
history: The flag was approved by the municipal council of Campllong on 19 September 2002 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3769 of 26 November 2002; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, red, with a white rose barbed and seeded yellow of diameter 4/9 of the height at the centre.
